title: Borel measurability of y ↦ 𝓗^k(Q ∩ f⁻¹{y}) for compact Q
statement: Let X be a metric space with its Borel σ-algebra, m ∈ ℕ, k > 0 real, Q ⊆ X compact and f : X → ℝᵐ continuous on Q. Then y ↦ 𝓗^k(Q ∩ f⁻¹{y}) (𝓗^k = (ω_k/2^k)μH[k] = Chapter01.simonHausdorffMeasureReal k) is a Borel measurable function ℝᵐ → [0,∞].
lean_statement: ∀ (X : Type) [MetricSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (m : ℕ) (k : ℝ) (Q : Set X) (f : X → Rn m), 0 < k → IsCompact Q → ContinuousOn f Q → Measurable (fun y ↦ Chapter01.simonHausdorffMeasureReal k (Q ∩ f ⁻¹' {y}))
